name: B10-0202/2024 (Renew) – The increasing and systematic repression of women in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the increasing and systematic repression of women in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on how women are treated in Iran. It condemns the repression, including a new law on hijab and chastity, and the plan for a clinic for women who defy hijab rules. It asks Iran to release people jailed for peaceful protest, scrap discriminatory laws, and let United Nations monitors in. It also asks the European Union to sanction those responsible and support Iranian women.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only asks for action; it does not decide it.
- **Who it affects:** Iranian women and girls, jailed activists, and Iranian civil society.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the European Union's Council and Commission, and to Iran's parliament and Supreme Leader.
